risk_surfaces.reason: The Express bootstrap must mount the existing periodization router before the generic 404 fallback.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Change only the frontend URL or import the router without mounting it before the generic 404 fallback.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The settings request still falls through to the global 404 handler.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: The router is imported but not mounted, or is mounted after the fallback.
negative_controls.procedure: Read back main.ts and verify the exact periodization mount exists before the generic 404 fallback and aligns with frontend/backend paths.
negative_controls.expected: The periodization mount precedes the fallback and the settings path resolves through GET /parameters.
negative_controls.observed: The candidate contains the mount before fallback and aligned frontend/backend parameter paths.

risk_surfaces.reason: Mounting the router must retain the module-wide authentication boundary.
Parameter administration remains restricted to professor context on the route.
The tenant identifier must continue to come from the authenticated request context.
The authenticated contractId must continue into service calls that read or mutate parameters.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Mount the router correctly but bypass one of its existing authentication or contract-scoping controls while making parameters reachable.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Unauthenticated requests can reach periodization parameter handlers.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Mount an alternate unprotected router or remove router.use(authMiddleware).
negative_controls.procedure: Read back periodization.routes.ts and verify router.use(authMiddleware) remains the module-wide guard.
negative_controls.expected: All periodization module routes remain behind authMiddleware.
negative_controls.observed: router.use(authMiddleware) is present on the mounted periodization router.

negative_controls.failure_mode: An authenticated non-professor context can administer training parameters.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep global authentication but remove professorMiddleware from GET /parameters.
negative_controls.procedure: Read back the GET /parameters declaration and verify professorMiddleware remains attached.
negative_controls.expected: The administrative parameters route retains professorMiddleware.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A client-selected contractId could escape the authenticated tenant boundary.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Accept contractId from query/body instead of deriving it from req.user.contractId.
negative_controls.procedure: Read back GET /parameters and verify contractId is derived from req.user.contractId.
negative_controls.expected: Tenant identity is server-owned from the authenticated request context.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The route could read parameters without constraining the service by contractId.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Derive contractId correctly but omit it when calling getAllParameters/getParametersByCategory.
negative_controls.procedure: Read back route service calls and verify contractId is passed into parameter read helpers.
negative_controls.expected: Every parameter read path remains scoped by the authenticated contractId.
negative_controls.observed: The route passes contractId to both parameter read service helpers.

risk_surfaces.reason: A source-contract test must fail if the route mount or client/backend path alignment regresses.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Fix the bootstrap once without a regression test, allowing a future refactor to silently remove the mount.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Future removal of the mount is not detected by a focused test.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Ship only the main.ts change and omit a contract test for mount order and path alignment.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the added test and verify it asserts import, manifest, mount ordering, path alignment, and middleware presence.
negative_controls.expected: The regression test contains discriminant assertions for the 404 root cause.
